system: You are an ambitious AI researcher who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: You are given experiment.py, which trains a plain-numpy logistic regression on synthetic two-moons data and compares learning rates {0.1, 0.3} over 3 trials x 3 seeds. Key metrics are test_loss, test_acc, best_lr and total_train_time in <out_dir>/final_info.json (shape {metric: {"means": float, "stderrs": float}}). The experiment must stay CPU-only, deterministic (EXP_SEED / fixed rng), under ~2 minutes, and must never download data from the internet. Propose and implement small modifications (optimizer, features, regularization, dataset geometry) that improve test_acc / lower test_loss versus run_0.
